name: create-site trigger queries
description: New-site onboarding (DA or Source Bus) should pick create-site; import, block work, auth/page-HTML/CLI work on existing sites and branding are near misses.

queries.query: I want to launch a brand-new site on Edge Delivery Services for my company acme-corp. Nothing exists yet, no repo and no content. Can you set the whole thing up and give me a preview link?

We're starting a new AEM Edge Delivery site and want its content stored in Source Bus (api.aem.live) rather than DA. We have a GitHub org, nothing else yet. Walk me through getting it created and previewable.
Create a new repo from the aem-boilerplate template for our org, get it connected so the .aem.page URL works, and put a starter homepage, nav and footer in place.
Set up a new EDS project called harbor-site under github org harbor-labs with a homepage that previews.
I made a repo from the boilerplate template yesterday. What else do I have to do before main--my-shop--my-org.aem.page serves anything, and where does the content live?
I'm onboarding a fresh Edge Delivery site. Should the content go in DA or Source Bus, and how do I wire up whichever it is?
The new repo is created and the code sync app is installed. Seed the first pages (home, nav, footer) so the site has something to show.
Spin up a demo Edge Delivery site for a customer pitch tomorrow: new GitHub repo, hooked up to AEM, starter content, live preview URL.
Migrate the pages of our existing marketing site www.example.com into our Edge Delivery project. Build the import script.
Add a new testimonial carousel block to our existing EDS site and make sure it works on mobile.
My script PUTs to api.aem.live/acme/sites/docs/source/index.html on an existing site and gets 403 although I'm logged in. What do I check?
I'm writing a hand-built HTML page for da.live with a cards block and some metadata. It previews empty. What did I get wrong?
aem up says the port is already in use in my existing project. How do I run the dev server?
Apply our brand colors, fonts and logo from the old website to the already-created Edge Delivery project.
The site acme/docs already exists and its content is in Source Bus. Upload a new about page and make it show on the preview.
Clone the DA content of our existing site locally, fix typos on three pages and push them back.
